datasets.title: Concentration by mineral
datasets.description: For eleven minerals: world mine production in 2024 and 2025 (USGS), the leading producers and their shares, the leading reserve holder, and China's and the top country's share of refining in 2025 (IEA).

datasets.title: Mine production by country
datasets.description: Mine production by country, 2024 and estimated 2025, share of the world total, and reserves (USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026).

datasets.title: Refining by country, 2025
datasets.description: Share of refined output by country for seven minerals in 2025, and the top producer's share in 2023 (IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026).

datasets.title: Top refining country for 20 minerals
datasets.description: Share held by the leading refining country, most recent year (IEA Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2025).

datasets.title: Mineral prices, 2021 to 2025
datasets.description: Annual average prices quoted by USGS, with the change from 2024 to 2025 (2025 estimated).

datasets.title: Base metal prices, monthly
datasets.description: Copper, nickel, aluminium and tin, US dollars a tonne, January 2019 to October 2026 (World Bank Pink Sheet).

datasets.title: Export controls
datasets.description: Export bans, licences and quotas on critical minerals since 2020, with status as of 6 November 2026.

datasets.title: Chinese tariff codes under export control
datasets.description: Number of eight-digit mineral tariff codes under Chinese export control (IEA).

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the map.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Published figures from USGS, the IEA, the OECD, Amnesty International, ITU, the European Commission, the UK government and the BGS.
